LanguageData.MI_DiffuseBrainDamage.label: diffuse brain damage
LanguageData.MI_DiffuseBrainDamage.description: Lasting damage reduces brain efficiency and can cause a vegetative state. Does not ordinarily heal; advanced neurological treatment or suitable regeneration can restore function.
LanguageData.MI_DiffuseBrainDamage.stages.minor.label: minor
LanguageData.MI_DiffuseBrainDamage.stages.major.label: major
LanguageData.MI_ArtificialComa.label: artificial coma
LanguageData.MI_ArtificialComa.description: Halves new hypoxic brain injury; consciousness capped at 10%. Restore oxygen delivery separately. Wake-up reverses it when permitted. After about seven days, lasting injury becomes possible; about ten days is fatal. Re-induction does not reset this timer. Organ-failure timers and vacuum hazards remain active.
LanguageData.MI_ArtificialComa.stages.dangerous.label: dangerous
